instruction.text: Arrange all objects in rows in the full workspace; long axes horizontal. Across the selected objects, order by bounding-rectangle area, largest first, left to right then top to bottom. Leave 15 mm horizontal gaps between neighboring bounding rectangles in a row. Use 15 mm vertical gaps between consecutive row bands. A row band spans the full height of that row's bounding rectangles.

Arrange only the blue objects in rows in the full workspace; long axes horizontal. Across the selected objects, order by bounding-rectangle area, largest first, left to right then top to bottom. Leave 15 mm horizontal gaps between neighboring bounding rectangles in a row. Use 15 mm vertical gaps between consecutive row bands. A row band spans the full height of that row's bounding rectangles. Keep all other objects fixed in position and orientation.
Keep every object at its current position and orientation.
